title: Nehemiah’s Prayer

questions.question: Who was the father of Nehemiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:1 (ESV): "The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah..."

questions.question: In which citadel was Nehemiah when he heard the news?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:1 (ESV): "...as I was in Susa the citadel..."

questions.question: Who brought Nehemiah news about the Jews and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:2 (ESV): "that Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah..."

questions.question: What was the condition of the wall of Jerusalem according to the report?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:3 (ESV): "...The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are destroyed by fire."

questions.question: What was Nehemiah’s position in the king’s court?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:11 (ESV): "Now I was cupbearer to the king."

questions.question: In which month did Nehemiah receive the report?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:1 (ESV): "Now it happened in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year..."

questions.question: How long did Nehemiah mourn, fast, and pray?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:4 (ESV): "...I continued fasting and praying before the God of heaven."

questions.question: What specific group represents the "servants" revered in Nehemiah's prayer?
options: Those who delight to fear your name
questions.correctAnswer: Those who delight to fear your name
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:11 (ESV): "...to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name..."

questions.question: Who did Nehemiah ask God to give him success before?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:11 (ESV): "Give success to your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man."

questions.question: Which commandment did Nehemiah say they had not kept?
options: The commandments, the statutes, and the rules given to Moses
questions.correctAnswer: The commandments, the statutes, and the rules given to Moses
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:7 (ESV): "...and have not kept the commandments, the statutes, and the rules that you commanded your servant Moses."

questions.question: What definition of God does Nehemiah use in his prayer?
options: God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and steadfast love
questions.correctAnswer: God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and steadfast love
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:5 (ESV): "O LORD God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and steadfast love..."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah recall God saying to Moses about unfaithfulness?
options: I will scatter you among the peoples
questions.correctAnswer: I will scatter you among the peoples
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:8 (ESV): "...If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples..."

questions.question: What condition did God give for gathering the scattered people?
options: If you return to me and keep my commandments
questions.correctAnswer: If you return to me and keep my commandments
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:9 (ESV): "but if you return to me and keep my commandments and do them..."

questions.question: Where did God say he would gather them to?
options: The place that I have chosen, to make my name dwell there
questions.correctAnswer: The place that I have chosen, to make my name dwell there
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:9 (ESV): "...I will gather them from there and bring them to the place that I have chosen, to make my name dwell there."

questions.question: How did Nehemiah describe the people to God in his plea?
options: These are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power
questions.correctAnswer: These are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:10 (ESV): "They are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand."

key_verse_text: O Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name, and give success to your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.
